newsitem.title: ITALY: Unicem stake sale to Fratelli Buzzi.
newsitem.headline: Unicem stake sale to Fratelli Buzzi.

text.p: Italian cement producer Unicem said on Tuesday that a 20.5 percent stake in the company currently held by Agnelli family holding IFIL will be sold to Fratelli Buzzi at 18,800 lire a share for 245 billion lire.
A Unicem statement added that fellow cement producer Fratelli Buzzi will launch a public buy offer (OPA) for Unicem shares in the future.
Earlier today, market regulator Consob said shares in Unicem had been suspended pending an announcement. Unicem shares closed at 12,467 lire/share on Monday.

The Agnelli family companies IFIL and IFI currently hold 50.3 percent of Unicem. In the deal, Fratelli Buzzi will have an option to acquire more shares from IFIL to increase its stake in Unicem to 27.6 percent.

The full deal is expected to be finalised in 1998. The IFIL stake is expected to be transferred in two tranches, the first tranche of 7.9 percent will be in June 1997 and the second tranche at the start of 1998. The OPA will be launched in the first months of 1998.
